newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Southgo to take joint-control of Chillers.
newsitem.headline: Southgo to take joint-control of Chillers.

text.p: South East Rand Gold Holdings Ltd said on Thursday it would take 32.6 percent stake in recently-listed Chillers Group Ltd in a move which would result in the joint control of Chillers.

Southgo said it would take up Chillers shares worth seven million rand at one rand a share in terms of a planned rights offer of 10.75 million new Chillers shares. A further 3.5 million Chillers shares would be exchanged for 17.5 million Southgo shares.
After the rights offer and share swap Southgo and a consortium currently holding 62.5 percent of Chillers would exercise joint control of Chillers.
Southgo shareholders were urged to exercise further caution in their sharedealings as talks were in place for more acquisitions.
